title: Fear of Allah and Repentance
summary: Crying with fear of Allah prevents Hellfire entry.
translation: Tonight is the night of Jumu'ah. You all are aware of the situation in Turkey, which certainly involves, in some way, our sins as well, causing distress to our brothers there. Therefore, especially make supplications for them, for yourselves, and for forgiveness of sins. When we pray, our supplications will have an effect. Particularly today, we all recognize our own sins and Allah is aware of those sins. Hence, we should cry and beseech in front of Allah. Allah loves this weeping very much. In the sacred Hadith, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said, 'The person who cries due to the fear of Allah will not enter Hell until the milk returns to the udder.' This means that once milk is taken out, it cannot return, similar to what is mentioned in the Quran—that a camel will not pass through the eye of the needle. Just as a camel cannot pass through the needle's eye, milk that has been extracted cannot return to the udder. Likewise, a sinful person who cries out of fear of Allah will never enter Hell and will never be cast into the Fire.
